items.headline: Elevated fire weather risk Friday
items.line: The SPC Day 1 fire weather outlook includes the venue and its period (Fri 10 a.m. – Sat 5 a.m.) overlaps the event. Elevated fire weather risk from wind and low relative humidity. It rates the weather and fuels for the whole period, not timing within it, and not whether a fire starts.

items.headline: Low chance of winter weather Friday · 10% chance of at least winter weather
items.line: WPC's winter storm severity outlook (WSSI-P) for the 24 hours Fri 5 p.m. – Sat 5 p.m. includes the venue and overlaps the event. Expect winter weather and winter driving conditions. A chance for the whole 24 hours, not timing within it.
